iti18:3.1: Āpāyiko → āpāy-, M.; apāy all other MSS. (pts note)
iti18:3.3: vaggārāmo adhammaṭṭho yogakkhemā padhaṁsati → yogakkhemato dhaṁsati (pts)
iti18:3.4: yogakkhemā padhaṁsati → yogakkhemato dhaṁsati (sya-all) | padhaṁsati → yogakkhemato dhaṁsati (cck: syā. pī.); yogakkhemā vimaṁsati (cck: sī. ka.) | dhaṁsati → yogakkhemā vidhaṁsati, M.; for dhaṁsati see Journ. P. T. S., 1885, p. 41. (pts note)
iti18:3.5: bhetvāna → bhitvāna (cck: sī. ka.); bhinditvā (cck: cūḷava. 354; a. ni. 10.39) | samaggaṁ → saṇghasāmaggi, B. (see sutt. 19). (pts note) | bhitvāna → bhetvāna, D. E. Pa. (pts note)
iti18:3.6: nirayamhi → nirayamhi (sic!) paccati--not niraye, in spite of the nine syllables--the counterpart of saggamhi modati in sutt. 19; nirayamhi ca, P. Pa. (pts note)
